All done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Diagnosis:** The latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was failing health checks across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Rollback:** I rolled back all regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. This didn't require change-manager approval since v2.3.0 was previously healthy.

**Verification:** Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy in all regions with an error rate of just 0.2%.

**Incident:** I opened a **SEV2 incident (INC-0002)** — "checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy" — documenting the failure and the rollback action taken. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: My first attempt to create the incident timed out, but I confirmed no incident had been created before retrying, so there's no duplicate.
